title: Implement Hash Diff Functions in C# Compose
description: Implement hash diff functions in /workspaces/semio/compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs for all diff entity types. Functions go inside the existing Hashing class within #region Hash, after HashKit. Must include value type diff hashes, generic collection diff hash helper, entity diff hashes, and collection diff wrapper functions. Must verify canonical hash for KitDiff and compilation.
summary:
Implemented all hash diff functions in C# Compose.cs inside the Hashing class. Added:
- 5 private helper methods (WriteDiffNullableString, WriteDiffOptString, WriteDiffOptNumber, WriteDiffOptIntNumber, WriteDiffOptBool) for diff field hashing with ShouldSerialize support
- Generic HashCollectionDiffGeneric<TEntity,TDiff> method for collection diff hashing (added/removed/updated with sorted update entry keys)
- 4 value type diff wrappers (HashCoordDiff, HashPointDiff, HashVectorDiff, HashPlaneDiff) using *Diff tags
- 20 entity diff hash functions: HashAttributeDiff, HashAuthorDiff, HashFileDiff, HashFolderDiff, HashBenchmarkDiff, HashQualityDiff (no _setProperties special case), HashTagDiff, HashConceptDiff, HashPortDiff, HashPropDiff, HashModelDiff, HashConnectorDiff, HashTypeDiff, HashSideDiff, HashLayerDiff, HashGroupDiff, HashStatDiff, HashConnectionDiff, HashPieceDiff, HashDesignDiff, HashKitDiff
- 14 collection diff hash functions: HashAttributesDiff, HashAuthorsDiff, HashFilesDiff, HashFoldersDiff, HashTagsDiff, HashConceptsDiff, HashPortsDiff, HashModelsDiff, HashConnectorsDiff, HashTypesDiff, HashConnectionsDiff, HashPiecesDiff, HashDesignsDiff, HashKitsDiff
- 6 tests: HashKitDiff_Canonical (verified d9ee3052111fec2e0fe08119eee6b8d5b6f5578a940f6d5c6bb1806e6e0f36a5), HashKitDiff_NameOnly, HashKitDiff_Empty, HashKitDiff_Deterministic, HashAttributeDiff_Deterministic, HashKitDiff_FieldOrderMatters
All 6 tests pass. Canonical hash matches TS/Go/Python/Rust.
